description: A tiled entrance hall with a wall of brass letterboxes, most of them with the name slot empty and a few with two names in the same slot. The stair goes up on the left, worn to a shine in the middle of each tread. There's a radiator that has been painted eleven times and a noticeboard with a residents' notice on it about the bins, undated, in a tone that suggests it has not worked.

window.description: A panel of reeded glass in the street door that turns the park into a green smear with a dark upright in the middle of it. If you want to know what the weather is doing you open the door.
window.name: the hall door glass

name: Statue Quo — Entrance Hall
